title: Cosine
text: Implement fixed-point sine or cosine wave using lookup table approach that exploits quarter wave symmetry, 1 input, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Output formula} sets Select the signals to output cos(2*pi*u); {Number of data points for lookup table} sets the number of data points to retrieve from the lookup, {Output word length} sets the word length for the fixed-point data type of the output and {Internal rule priority for lookup table} sets the internal rule for intermediate calculations. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: u
ports.summary: Input signal to implement as fixed-point sine or cosine wave real-valued signal

ports.name: sin(2*pi*u)
ports.summary: Fixed-point sine wave real-valued fixed-point signal

ports.name: cos(2*pi*u)
ports.summary: Fixed-point cosine wave real-valued fixed-point signal

params.name: Output formula
params.values: Select the signals to output cos(2*pi*u) | sin(2*pi*u) | exp(j*2*pi*u) | sin(2*pi*u) and cos(2*pi*u)

params.name: Number of data points for lookup table
params.values: Specify the number of data points to retrieve from the lookup table (2^5)+1 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Output word length
params.values: Specify the word length for the fixed-point data type of the output signal 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 53

params.name: Internal rule priority for lookup table
params.values: Specify the internal rule for intermediate calculations Speed (default) | Precision
